prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fan-made production sprite sheet for a side-view tactical video game, faithful to Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain (1984). EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 independently DRAWN full-body poses of ONE same character. Pure flat magenta #FF00FF canvas with five thin continuous pure cyan #00FFFF vertical grid lines and five horizontal grid lines, including outer boundaries. Each equal square cell must contain exactly one complete character, wholly inside, generous empty margin at least 30 pixels, no extremity or equipment on guides. Fixed camera, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile, feet bottom aligned, identical physical scale every frame. Detailed crisp military pixel art, clear small-scale silhouette, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. The sixteen poses must be genuinely different drawings, never simple shifted duplicates. Four phases per row in left-to-right time order, preserve all costume and identity features in EVERY pose. Keep weapons and hands compact inside their cell.
Subject: Quiet, the adult female sniper from MGSV TPP, athletic lean adult woman, brown hair in ponytail with side-swept fringe, accurate recognizable face. Standard game field outfit as seen in Konami Play Arts Kai Quiet: dark charcoal tactical bikini top, olive utility belt and webbing with hip ammunition pouches, torn brown-black sheer tights, olive thigh holster/straps, dark lace-up combat boots, black fingerless gloves. Neutral functional depiction, no erotic posing or exaggerated anatomy. A compact long-barreled scoped sniper rifle, held with BOTH hands correctly, rifle stays within frame. Row1 IDLE: four subtle steady breathing poses with rifle lowered diagonally, restrained tactical alertness. Row2 MOVE: four independent compact right-facing stalking/walking steps with rifle carried low, ponytail shifting slightly, no jumping stretch. Row3 INTERACT: four phases of lowering to a compact kneeling observation stance, brief two-finger buddy signal, checking scope, rising; do not face camera. Row4 ATTACK: four timed poses aiming right, trigger pull, visible physical rifle recoil without muzzle-flash VFX, recover aim. Keep body, outfit, hair and full rifle identical in every cell. Both feet, head and rifle muzzle fully contained with large margins, not a generic bikini pinup.
CRITICAL QUALITY CONTRACT: every nose points RIGHT, even reactions and radio use. All 16 poses strict right-facing profile. No isolated white marks, no breath puff, no comic symbols, no decorative pixels at all. Walking row four timed phases: right heel strike, compressed weight bearing, left leg passing, left heel strike. Do not repeat the same long-stride pose four times. Emphasize genuinely different leg positions. Maintain all cyan guides exactly 4x4.

notes: Adult tactical silhouette, ponytail, webbing, torn tights, sniper rifle retained.
All 16 authored poses facing right; no white puff remains.
128px adaptation; exact 1:1 likeness and perfect motion continuity are not claimed.

rejected.reason: Detached white breath mark; insufficiently phased walking.
